title: 第五章    不卖了
content_zh:
这叫王艺的男子明显是一直在给这名女子出主意，给她的母亲看病，不过几年下来应该是效果甚微，从这个有些学生气的女子眼神中可以明显看到疲惫，所以陈木知道，这些年这个王艺给她母亲看病的医生应该全都没有治好。

    想到这里，陈木想到自己的护心丸，这名女子的母亲应该是心脉受到损伤，按照他这几天了解的情况来看，这个世界上应该还没有人能够治疗心脉受伤的技术。

    陈木不想浪费机会，既然这名女子能够在这里买那些假药，那买他的药应该不成问题，当然陈木的药自然不是假药，陈木也不可能卖假药，对他一名曾经的渡劫修真者来说，也不屑。

    “祖传药丸，专治疑难杂症、心脉受伤的、各种内科毛病，一粒立刻见效、两粒彻底痊愈。。。”

    陈木对着那名十分漂亮的美女那边叫道。

    苏林依立刻听到了陈木的声音，顿时心里一喜，本来有些没有目的瞎逛，立刻来到了陈木的摊位。

    “老板，你的药丸真的可以治愈心肌绞痛之类的症状？”苏林依急忙的问道，自己的母亲即将面临死亡，医生已经宣判了死刑，只是让她眼睁睁的看着母亲死去，她做不到，此刻苏林依仿若抓住了最后的一根救命稻草。

    陈木见到苏林依上钩了，微微一笑，他自然有信心可以治好那些小毛小病，当然这也是对于他一个渡劫期的修真者来说，如果这种普通凡人的病症都治不好，那不如直接死了好了，如果他现在的修为还是渡劫期，恐怕只需要轻轻一指，就可以让天地灵气将这个女孩的母亲的病症治愈。

    不过现在陈木只有练气一层，地球的灵气更是十分稀薄，虽然他有着修炼到大乘期的功法，但如果没有灵气支撑，也是晋级不了，叹了口气，陈木心想，现在还是做下这笔生意再说吧。

    “这药丸是我的祖传秘方，自然没有问题，不要说只是心肌绞痛，就算是心脏病晚期，只要服下我的药丸，也能够瞬间痊愈。。”

    陈木生怕苏林依不信，将功能一五一十的，全部说给了苏林依听。苏林依皱了皱眉，虽然她有些不信陈木的话，不过还是问道：“我母亲现在在医院，医生说她没有几天了，我母亲是心肌绞痛突然昏迷过去，而且几年的老毛病了，请问我要买哪瓶药丸？”

    苏林依不想浪费时间，她想尽快将药丸买回去给母亲服下。
content_en:
This man named Wang Yi has obviously been giving advice to this woman and treating her mother. However, after a few years, the effect should be very little. The fatigue can be clearly seen in the eyes of this somewhat student-like woman, so Chen Mu knows that the doctors Wang Yi has treated her mother in these years must not have cured her.

Thinking of this, Chen Mu thought of his heart-protecting pill. This woman's mother should have suffered damage to her heart vessels. According to what he had learned in the past few days, no one in the world should have the technology to treat injuries to her heart vessels.

Chen Mu didn't want to waste the opportunity. Since this woman could buy those fake medicines here, it shouldn't be a problem to buy his medicines. Of course, Chen Mu's medicines were certainly not fake medicines, and Chen Mu couldn't sell fake medicines. For him, a former tribulation cultivator, he was disdainful.

"The pills passed down from our ancestors are specially designed to treat difficult and complicated diseases, heart and pulse injuries, and various internal diseases. One pill is effective immediately, and two pills will completely cure you..."

Chen Mu shouted to the very beautiful beauty.

Su Linyi immediately heard Chen Mu's voice and felt happy. He was wandering around aimlessly and immediately came to Chen Mu's stall.

"Boss, can your pills really cure symptoms such as myocardial angina?" Su Linyi asked hurriedly. Her mother was about to die. The doctor had already sentenced her to death, but she just wanted her to watch her mother die. She couldn't do it. At this moment, Su Linyi seemed to have grasped the last life-saving straw.

Chen Mu saw that Su Linyi had taken the bait and smiled. He was naturally confident that he could cure those minor illnesses. Of course, this was also for him as a cultivator in the Tribulation Stage. If such an ordinary mortal's disease could not be cured, it would be better to just die. If his current cultivation level was still in the Tribulation Stage, I am afraid that with just a finger, the aura of heaven and earth could cure the girl's mother's illness.

But now Chen Mu only has one level of Qi training, and the spiritual energy of the earth is very thin. Although he has the skills to practice to the Mahayana stage, without the support of spiritual energy, he will not be able to advance. Sighing, Chen Mu thought to himself, it is better to do this business now.

"This pill is my ancestral secret recipe, so there is no problem. Don't say it's just myocardial angina. Even if you have a late-stage heart disease, you can be cured instantly as long as you take my pills."

Chen Musheng was afraid that Su Linyi would not believe it, so he told Su Linyi all the functions.Su Linyi frowned. Although she didn't believe Chen Mu's words, she still asked: "My mother is in the hospital now. The doctor said she has only a few days to live. My mother suddenly passed out due to myocardial angina and has been suffering from the same problem for several years. Which bottle of pills should I buy?"

Su Linyi didn't want to waste time. She wanted to buy the pills as soon as possible for her mother to take.
